Initial release of memory-tuner: tracks and optimizes MEMORY.md entries based on access frequency.

- Implements usage tracking (埋点) of MEMORY.md entries per session, storing logs under memory/.track/.
- Provides a Python analysis script (scripts/memory-tuner.py) to generate heat reports, suggest actions (promote, downgrade, clean), and check memory limits.
- Introduces multi-level handling: hot entries are promoted, cold entries are archived, frozen entries are cleaned, and "keep" entries are protected.
- Supports automated or manual maintenance, with actionable, Markdown-formatted reports.
- Integrates with existing workflows without interfering with dreaming or memory_search logic.
